findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: The mop in the store room is observed to be stored directly in the mop water and not able to air dry. This mop was placed in the top portion of the mop bucket to allow it to air dry between uses. Ensure that staff is educated on proper storage of the mop to allow it to air dry. 
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The walk-in freezer is observed to have insulation falling off the pipe with ice build-up. PIC stated there is a work order placed for the unit to have this insulation repaired. Ensure the insulation is repaired in a manner that prevents ice accumulation.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The lightbulb casing in the walk-in freezer is observed to have an accumulation of ice. This casing should be removed to monitor the issue and determine if there is water entering the fixture by a leak or if it condensation build-up inside the casing. The facility utilizes shatterproof bulbs and the casing may remain off the light fixture if the moisture is condensation related.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: There is an ant trail in the kitchen going to a sweet potato fry on the ground. There are bait traps in place int he kitchen. Facility is going to remove the fry, clean the area with bleach to get rid of the scent trail, and then will keep the bait traps in place until the issue is eradicated. More than likely, the construction taking place is causing the ants to migrate throughout the building. Maintenance is aware of the issue. PIC and inspector are going to communicate via text to confirm the issue has been eradicated.
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a steady leak at the left faucet of the 3-pan sink. Repair faucet to stop leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
The top racks of food and two pans of food in the walk-in cooler were uncovered.  The food was covered to CORRECT the violation.

750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The top inside of the lid on the Norlake milk cooler in the hallway is coming apart and the bottom is corroded in places.  It is scheduled to be replaced in the next year.  Replace or repair the cooler.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
(A) The metal cart to the left of the gas stove has legs and a lower shelf that are chipped.  Sand and paint it.
(B) The urinals and stool in the men's restroom have gaps between the plumbing and wall.  Seal the gaps.
(C) The orange juice cooler in the hallway has a torn door gasket and the top is chipped. Replace the gasket.   Sand and paint the top,
(D) The bottom inside of the milk cooler nearest the outside doors in the hallway is corroded.  Sand and paint the corroded area.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The two milk coolers in the hallway nearest the exterior doors have an ice build-up in the top inside.  Defrost the coolers.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The hot water at the left handsink in the women's restroom barely flows water.  Repair the faucet.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
The waste baskets in the men's and women's bathrooms have no covers.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall have easily cleanable, covered receptacles for waste materials.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
The exterior door in the kitchen was not self-closing.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
The door closer was adjusted to make the door self-closing.  A new closer has been ordered as the old one is weak.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The joint between the spray sink and wall is becoming moldy (in the dish washing area).
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.
Remove the old caulk from the wall-to-sink joint, disinfect the area, and re-caulk the joint.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) can opener blade & B) sprayer (buildup in crevice around where water comes out). Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - Cold water handle of the right faucet at the dish area 3 part sink leaks. Get the faucet repaired so the cold water handle does not leak. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) spice shelf above 3 part sink; B) inside oven mitt drawer (crumbs); C) bottom inside hotbox (food splash); D) walkin cooler shelves (debris/mold in a few spots); & E) under small warmer on front line (food debris on counter underneath). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - Drawer holding clean utensils (whisk, spatula) was soiled. Cleaned and sanitized utensils and equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Clean the utensil storage drawer and maintain it clean to protect utensils being stored in the drawer from potential contamination.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floors were in general soiled along walls behind equipment and behind the ice machine in the main kitchen area. Also, a dead spider & a marker top were observed under a shelving unit shelving unit in the walkin freezer, and a dead bug was observed on the floor under shelves in the dry storage area. Clean the floors daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris. B) Floor to wall joint along walkin units and at the corner by the back door was observed to have a gap. Re-seal the floor to wall joint (caulk, etc.) to eliminate potential hiding places for pests.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Bleach solution used for wiping non-food contact surfaces was less than 100ppm. The solution had been made around 9am (tested around 9:30am by inspector). The water was warm, and a slight bleach smell was present. The test strip on the side of the garbage showed the solution was at 100ppm when it was first made. Staff was advised if the water is too hot it will dissolve the bleach out of the solution. The bleach solution was remade and tested at 100ppm. **Make sure all staff know how to properly prepare sanitizer solution, use test strips to verify concentration, and the solution must be maintained at 100ppm**

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were observed to be soiled: A) can opener blade (buildup) & B) ice scoop holder (general debris). Wash, rinse, and sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of food and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 - Floor is starting to peel around the drain by the dish machine. All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents. Smooth out and reseal the floor around the drain.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - Paint is starting to peel off the wall by the mopsink. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning. Repaint the wall by the mopsink.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed self-serve ice, celery and pears on the table for staff without a cover or sneeze guard.  Protect food.
750-120 At all times food shall be protected from potential contamination. Provide sneeze guard for salad/food bar.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Observed two dented cans of ketchup.  Cans were set aside for return.
750-155  Discard or set aside severely dented cans or cans with any dent that involves a seem.
